case.caption: In re The Roman Catholic Bishop of Oakland, a California corporation sole
case.court: U.S. Bankruptcy Court, N.D. California, Oakland Division
case.claims_agent_note: kccllc.net/RCBO now redirects to https://www.veritaglobal.net/RCBO (Kurtzman Carson rebranded as Verita); not reachable from the collection environment
case.status_as_of_2026_10_25: In Chapter 11; confirmation of the Modified Fourth Amended Plan denied (memorandum decision Oct 2, 2026; amended Oct 15, 2026). Debtor's motion to amend findings / reconsider set for Nov 18, 2026.

docket_entries_approx.note: highest ECF number seen (Oct 21, 2026 operating report); elevenflo says the docket has 4,015 entries, which may count sub-entries

milestones.title: RCBO files Chapter 11 petition to facilitate settlements with abuse survivors (~330+ pending lawsuits)
Claims bar date for abuse claims passes; 407 claims to be resolved (per diocese)
Diocese update on mediation, insurer litigation, and Nov 8, 2024 plan-exclusivity deadline
Original Plan of Reorganization and Disclosure Statement filed: Survivors' Trust $160M-$198M for ~345 claims ($103M RCBO, $43-81M real estate, $14.25M RCWC/schools)
Amended (First Amended) Plan filed
Second Amended Plan / Disclosure Statement filed (trust 'potentially exceeding $160 million': $63M cash, Livermore property $43-81M, $14.25M RCWC contingent); later withdrawn for corrections
Third Amended Plan filed: ~$143.5M ($115M diocese cash + up to $28.5M RCWC; $55M exit loan)
Court approves Third Amended Disclosure Statement; ballots due May 30, 2025; confirmation hearings to start Aug 25, 2025
milestones.note: elevenflo dates the updated disclosure statement Apr 3 and the order setting confirmation Apr 8, 2025

milestones.title: Ballot deadline on Third Amended Plan
Voting declaration filed: ~99% of abuse claimants reject Third Amended Plan
Creditors' Committee (UCC) objects to confirmation of Third Amended Plan
Bishop: no settlement reached; sales of non-essential real estate to begin
Debtor moves to dismiss the case under 11 U.S.C. 1112(b)
Diocese offers $165M over five years to 345 survivors ($160M for known claims; avg >$463K)
Court rejects UCC bad-faith argument; any dismissal would be without prejudice; ruling stayed to allow mediation
Mediators report at hearing; two-week extension granted before Thanksgiving
Conditional dismissal order: case dismissed unless settlement term sheet filed by Dec 11, 2025
Court approves sale of 1834 San Antonio Avenue, Alameda, for $1,860,000
Non-binding term sheet filed among RCBO, RCWC and settling insurers (~$242M: diocese $200M over five years + >$42.5M from three insurers); case stays open
Parties tell court they are ready for another month of talks
Debtor files renewed motion to sell 1822 San Antonio Avenue, Alameda
Status conference; court had ordered mediation to continue
Status conference: parties at impasse on funding timeline
Fourth Amended Plan filed (~$224.3M: RCBO $150M over 3.5 yrs, RCWC $30M, insurers ~$44.3M)
Creditors' Committee files competing plan (~$195.2M from diocese; optional $118.9M RCWC for up to ~$314.1M)
Modified Fourth Amended Plan of Reorganization (dated Mar 27, 2026), the plan taken to confirmation trial
Diocese announces closure of 13 East Bay church sites (Mission Alignment; to proceed regardless of bankruptcy outcome)
Confirmation hearing on court calendar (9:00 AM, Judge Lafferty)
Hearing on Cathedral lease extension

Memorandum decision (109 pp.) DENYING confirmation of Modified Fourth Amended Plan: liquidation analysis errors (unsupported property valuations, liquidation-expense assumptions), claim-estimate/funding issues; no religious-entity leniency; bad-faith allegations rejected; judge signals a revised plan could be confirmable
Amended memorandum decision after hearing on confirmation
milestones.note: elevenflo lists ECF 3568 in filings but links it as Dkt 3567

milestones.title: Debtor's motion to amend findings and/or for reconsideration of specific issues (with notice of hearing, Dkt 3570)
Order enlarging memorandum page limit
September 2026 monthly operating report filed
SCHEDULED: hearing on debtor's motion to amend findings / reconsideration (10:30 AM, Oakland Room 220)
